specification.objective: Supersede team-normal-surfaces-v5 selected employee border: equal 2px accessible semantic yellow in normal and high contrast.

requirements.statement: Selected employee card uses the theme semantic yellow indicator with 2px border in both contrast modes, minimum 3:1 against card and adjacent composited panel.
Preserve unselected border, selection semantics, keyboard focus and activation, light/dark and mobile/desktop behavior.
Run full affected widget test files, archive v6 lock byte-identically.

acceptance_criteria.statement: At both sizes and brightnesses, selected border uses semantic indicator with width 2 and at least 3:1 against card and adjacent panel; semantics and keyboard work.
Full contrast and employee widget suites execute, preserving global toggle and interaction.
Archived v6 contract is byte-identical to external lock.

invariants.statement: Unselected borders, focus, selection, semantics and unrelated surfaces remain unchanged.

forbidden_states.statement: Selected border differs in width by contrast mode or lacks accessible contrast.

inputs.statement: Employee list and profile widgets and global theme.

outputs.statement: Normalized scoped surfaces and regression coverage.

failure_semantics.statement: Widget regression fails on missing selected semantic yellow border.

baseline_output_contains: Employee selection border must use accessible theme yellow
